AC 9: 'verified by grep over `adapters/jira_family/`' — no grep command given

findings.finding: Two ACs specify 'verified by grep' for import-graph constraints without providing the exact grep pattern: AC 3 ('no module under `adapters/jira/` imports a name from a sibling adapter package… verified by grep at this story's merge time') and AC 9 ('verified by grep over `adapters/jira_family/`'). The durable AST-walking test (AC 8) covers the same invariant permanently, but the merge-time grep is listed as a separate required check with no actionable command. An executor cannot determine whether the merge-time grep is redundant with AC 8 or an additional gate, and cannot automate it without inventing the pattern.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria — AC bullet 3 and AC bullet 9
scenarios: Executor treats AC 3/9 as satisfied by AC 8 and ships; reviewer insists on a separate merge-time grep but has no spec to check against — creates unnecessary back-and-forth.
Executor runs an incorrect grep (e.g. grepping for the module name substring rather than the import statement) and produces a false-negative result that silently passes.
